source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Remove AC power and CMOS battery. Wait for motherboard out of power and re-insert the battery. 2. Power on the system and enter BIOS setup menu
3. Check BIOS setting

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. BIOS setting should be loaded to default setting and also BIOS time should be reset to like 2000.1.1 XXXX.
2. Administrator or User password should NOT be cleared

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: physical chassis access + CMOS battery removal (operator)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Remove CMOS battery: remove AC power and the CMOS battery, short the clear pads, then confirm BIOS returns to defaults and time resets. A physical chassis/service action the agent cannot perform.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator removes AC + CMOS battery, clears CMOS, reboots and confirms default settings and reset time; agent cannot physically remove hardware.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED; rejects that invention and protects defaults, RTC, password presence and recovery.

original_test_intent: Verify that vendor-approved CMOS battery removal/reinsertion resets BIOS settings and RTC to documented defaults while preserving administrator and user password presence.
original_method: A qualified operator records the complete BIOS/password/RTC baseline, removes AC and the CMOS battery using the vendor service procedure, waits for discharge, reinstalls it, enters BIOS and records default, time and password-preservation results.
manual_activity: AC isolation, chassis access, battery removal/reinsertion and BIOS observation are core operator actions; the agent may organize pre/post read-only OS/BMC evidence only.
required_inputs: Complete BIOS/default and operational restore baseline
ESD, maintenance and OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Obtain approval for AC removal, chassis opening and battery service; observe ESD and polarity rules.
Do not short clear pads because the master procedure does not request it unless a separate vendor-approved instruction explicitly does.
Never record password secrets; preserve boot/storage/security settings needed for recovery.
Stop on ambiguous battery/procedure, unexpected password clearing or boot/BMC loss; no automatic repeat.
agent_execution_scope: Capture supporting SUT/firmware identity, OS time and boot/storage/security/BMC health before and after operator service.
Compare supplied BIOS screenshots/baselines and prepare findings without claiming physical work or verdict.
engineer_actions: Perform the approved battery procedure and capture BIOS defaults, RTC and password-presence evidence.
Restore approved operational settings safely and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its physical/manual classification fits, but the added instruction to short clear pads is unsupported by the source and must not be executed.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use vendor service instructions for the physical action; collect only read-only supporting OS/BMC state after operator handoff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source battery-removal method and 15/15-minute values remain; no extra clear mechanism is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a versioned vendor service SOP and full BIOS configuration diff, treating defaults, RTC and password presence as separate acceptance dimensions.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact motherboard/BIOS and CMOS battery assembly.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board revision, BIOS/BMC, battery part and SOP revision.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor chassis/CMOS battery service and BIOS default documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds complete baseline/recovery and removes the unsupported clear-pad step.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects security/password or boot/storage regressions beyond a few visible defaults.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Vendor SOP and expected defaults/RTC behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: RTC reset is platform-specific; OS time after synchronization cannot substitute for the immediate BIOS value.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define the expected RTC epoch and settings to restore, but cannot add an unapproved clear mechanism or expose credentials.
expected_evidence: Board/BIOS identity and vendor battery SOP
Post-service BIOS defaults and RTC evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The master procedure and criteria are clear; the unsupported clear-pad phrase is in a prior AI overlay and is explicitly rejected, not treated as source intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The vendor/operator workflow is concrete once project baselines are provided; the physical and BIOS core makes it MANUAL ONLY.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains its manual boundary but rejects the invented clear-pad action.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps its RTC, password-safe, baseline and recovery protections.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates supporting agent evidence from physical execution and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents an unrequested board-short operation and ensures a successful reset does not silently damage password, boot, storage or security state.
independent_technical_reasoning: Battery removal is a board-specific physical reset whose expected NVRAM, RTC and password effects vary; only the vendor procedure plus direct BIOS evidence can establish the source criteria.
